question: Does the pxp skill and CLI bundle improve implementation versus neither?

protocol.prompt:
Build a reusable upload-status component in the supplied Daylight React app from upload-modal-multifiles.png. Extract todoapp.tar.gz into outputs/app. Use upload-state.json for the initial seven-item state. Match the reference as closely as you can with real accessible UI, not an embedded screenshot or traced substitute. This is a local demo, not a Shared Drive integration.

Cancel removes an active item. Cancel all removes active items but keeps failed and completed items. Retry changes the failed item back to uploading. The chevron toggles the list. Keep the component reusable and provide a working isolated preview without breaking the original app.

Capture the initial and final versions in Chromium at 436 by 406 CSS pixels, device scale 1, transparent background, including the reference's shadow padding. Use fixed demo state, wait for fonts, disable animation and carets, and preserve both original-sized screenshots. Save source, screenshots, behavior checks, capture instructions, and a brief honest summary of remaining differences under outputs/. Do not claim exact visual equality without evidence. Stop after at most five visual refinement iterations; finish tests and documentation within the 15-minute execution budget.

Work only in this disposable run directory except for installed tooling and package dependencies. Use the tools available in this environment; do not fetch or install additional comparison tools. Installing the app's locked npm dependencies is allowed. Browser automation is available through playwright-cli. Bind servers to loopback, use a unique short browser-session name (at most eight characters), and close your browser and server when done. Do not make Git commits or access saved answers, prior runs, or other projects.
assertions: Delivered source builds and implements a real reusable accessible DOM component, without rendering the reference image as the implementation.
Initial rendered component contains all seven fixture names and correct two uploading, one failed, four completed states.
Cancel, Cancel all preserving failed/completed rows, Retry, and collapse/expand work; controls have accessible names and keyboard operation.
Original app tests are retained and pass, with no detected task/attachment regression.
Original reference and first/final full-size 436x406 browser screenshots are retained with reproducible DPR1, stable-state capture instructions; no resizing or hidden defects.
A fresh reviewer capture of delivered source reproduces the delivered final image under the recorded conditions; final claims are supported by artifacts and the refinement budget is respected.
Human blind review finds the final component visually acceptable relative to the reference, considering content, geometry, typography, colors, icons, and effects.
protocol.isolation: macOS sandbox denylist plus curated PATH. Repository/saved answers, global skill/session history, control data, and peer run denied. Baseline additionally denies installed pxp. No added tools permitted by common prompt; transcripts will be checked. Not a general hostile-code sandbox.
protocol.baseline: No skill and no Pixel Perfect CLI; common browser/app tooling available.
protocol.assisted: Copied pxp skill plus installed Pixel Perfect CLI.
protocol.grading: Coordinator independent executable checks and post-run CLI measurements on both; human blind visual review. No paid model grader. One pair is not reliability evidence.

scope: One sequential pair. No automatic reruns, paid graders, or extra model calls.
interpretation: Baseline terminated successfully but did not satisfy the raw screenshot evidence contract.
Assisted was interrupted at the 900-second cap. Its unfinished state is not a completed candidate and cannot establish a visual winner.

Browser selection diverged: baseline used the default browser; assisted selected installed Chrome and fell back to Chrome 152 over CDP after browser-launch errors. The default browser had passed both preflights; its exact version was not recorded in this pilot.
Do not compare submitted final image scores: baseline final depicts five post-interaction items and was postprocessed; assisted edited source after its latest screenshot.
Usage totals include cached input, not just generated tokens. Assisted usage covers completed messages only and may omit the interrupted final generation.

evidence_issues: Original initial screenshot overwritten during refinement.
Opaque browser screenshots converted to RGBA by custom pixel processing; originals deleted.
Final screenshot intentionally shows five items after Cancel/Cancel all/Retry, not the unchanged seven-item scene.
without_skill.tool_errors_scope: Tool results marked isError; exit-zero error text counted separately.

next_step: Before a newly authorized pair, pin the tested browser and explicitly require raw initial/final screenshots of the unchanged seven-item fixture. Rerun both conditions with the same revised protocol; do not selectively rerun only assisted.
